title: Floci: Locally emulating any cloud service
summary: Floci is a development tool that enables developers to locally emulate any cloud service, allowing for faster iteration and testing without relying on actual cloud infrastructure. The tool aims to simplify the development workflow by providing a local environment that mimics cloud services behavior.
problem_solved: Enables developers to test cloud-dependent applications locally without needing actual cloud service credentials or paying for cloud usage
why_valuable: Significantly reduces development cycle time and costs by allowing offline cloud service emulation while maintaining production-like behavior
